geometry.note: Direction and spacing are sourced; the position of the whole line inside the hall is bounded by constraints (up to 20 m), not published, so the confidence is 'derived'.

method: DERIVED line from sourced positions along a sourced direction, anchored to the ground by the constraint set described below; no map shape was traced. From the WGTS coil-system centre (z = -38.87 m) to the detector coil-system centre (z = +13.78 m) of Table 1 in src:geo-kit-katrin-aircoil-2013, that is 52.65 m, along the bearing 16 deg. It does not reach the ~70 m overall length of the setup (src:geo-kit-katrin-tdr-2004, src:geo-kit-katrin-design-paper) because the rear section upstream of the WGTS and the detector system downstream of its coil are not given positions in any fetched source. PLACEMENT (the same for the axis and the vessel footprint). Direction: the KATRIN Collaboration writes 'The experiment has an orientation of xi ~ 16 deg east to the local north N' (src:geo-kit-katrin-lorentz-2022); the long sides of the OSM KATRIN outline (way 394890935) run at 15.8-16.1 deg, which is independent agreement, not an input. Positions along the axis: Table 1 of src:geo-kit-katrin-aircoil-2013 gives the centres of the coil systems relative to the centre of the main spectrometer (z = 0): WGTS -38.87 m, DPS -27.25, CPS -20.58, pre-spectrometer coils -16.46 and -12.10, pinch coil +12.18, detector coil +13.78. Where z = 0 lies on the ground is NOT published; it was bounded by three facts: (1) the main spectrometer vessel, 23.23 m long and 9.8 m in diameter (src:geo-kit-katrin-design-paper), lies inside the OSM KATRIN outline; (2) the detector coil (z = +13.78 m) lies inside the same outline; (3) the WGTS (z = -38.87 m) stands in Tritium Laboratory building 452 ('Rear system and WGTS will be installed in the existing TLK building'; 'The Tritium Laboratory (building 452)'; src:geo-kit-katrin-tdr-2004) whose OSM outline is way 99082477. In the 16-degree frame (a along the axis, b to the left, origin 49.0957 N 8.4360 E) the outline is a 53 m x 19 m stepped polygon; scanning z = 0 over a 0.25 m grid, the placements satisfying (1)-(3) span a = -13.3 to +14.0 m and b = -1.8 to +7.5 m (1806 of the grid points); adding the pre-spectrometer coils inside the outline narrows a to -8.5..+14.0 m, and adding the DPS and CPS (the TDR puts the transport system in a new building that 'will become part of TLK') narrows it to +2.3..+14.0 m. z = 0 is drawn at the centre of the set (a = 6.4 m, b = 3.0 m, i.e. 49.0957631 N, 8.4359846 E); the largest distance from it to any feasible placement is 19.7 m, hence accuracy_m 20. Everything relative (the 52.65 m between coil-system centres, the 16 deg direction) is sourced; the absolute position inside the hall is not. Haversine measure of the drawn line: 52.644 m on R = 6371008.8 m.
name: KATRIN beam axis from the source (WGTS) coil system to the detector coil system
notes: Overall length: the setup is 'about 70 m' (design report, collaboration paper); this line is the sourced 52.65 m core of it.
Accuracy 20 m is about the whole hall's width: treat the line as 'in the hall, along 16 degrees', not as a survey.

summary.plain: The path the electrons follow from the tritium source in the Tritium Laboratory, through the pumping sections and the main spectrometer, to the detector, drawn along the published direction and spacing.
